South Africa's diamond output fell 37% year on year in the third quarter, and the government has formed a task team for the industry.

De Beers' South African production fell to 418,000 carats, IDEX Online reports, after De Beers announced a two-year pause at Venetia in July. Minister Gwede Mantashe said the team would review the sector's pressures; no budget has been announced.

First reported for our Antwerp desk, @caratcapital.eu. Full story on caratcapital.org, link in bio.

Agnico Eagle's gold output fell 6.1% in the third quarter, and the miner points to lower grades.

A rockfall shut Canadian Malartic's Barnat pit on 1 July; the mine made 29.1% less gold than a year earlier. Realised prices rose 22.7% to $4,264 an ounce in the same quarter, the miner's SEC filing shows.
